name: Florals
description: A coordinated collection of 30 floral and botanical motifs designed from approved reference sheets to remain readable across cross stitch, C2C crochet, tapestry crochet and latch-hook/rug formats.
description_es: Colección coordinada de 30 motivos florales y botánicos basados en láminas de referencia aprobadas y diseñados para conservar una buena lectura en punto de cruz, crochet C2C, tapestry crochet y alfombra/latch hook.

palette_policy.rule: Every canonical floral source and every derived technique matrix must use only this collection palette plus transparency. Do not add generated colors.

canonical_artwork_policy.exact_motif_rule: Each F#### design must reproduce the motif assigned to its exact reference sheet cell. Do not redesign, substitute, combine or invent motifs.
canonical_artwork_policy.framing_rule: Keep the complete motif visible with transparent breathing room; never crop petals, leaves, stems, vessels, bows or hanging elements.
canonical_artwork_policy.extraction_rule: Create one transparent canonical source per design before generating technique-specific matrices.
canonical_artwork_policy.regeneration_rule: If a generated canonical source materially differs from the approved reference cell, reject it and regenerate before any product/PDF build.

generation.purpose: Reusable page-1 lifestyle/ambient images for the Florals collection.
generation.frame_requirement: Leave the craft display area empty so the final vector pattern can be inserted by the renderer.
generation.post_generation_measurement: Record exact source dimensions and usable area geometry after approval.
